merchant/31304.htm.text: Trader Astrid: It is wise to be careful in your purchasing. Not everything that glitters is gold, after all! That is especially true for accessories. merchant/31304-pk.htm.text: Trader Astrid: Just because we live in chaotic times, did you think that you would be treated any better? You fool! I don't want anything to do with you! Leave!
